headlines.title: US and Iran Trade New Strikes as the War Enters its 7th Month
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are exchanging new attacks across the Middle East, following days of renewed threats from both sides. CENTCOM says the U.S. struck Iranian air defense sites, radar systems and other military targets in response to Iran’s recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Watch: Judge in Lindsay Clancy trial tells deadlocked jury a verdict is 'desirable'
headlines.description: After a second deadlock note in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, Judge William Sullivan reads to the jury the Tuey-Rodriguez instructions, which asks them to give deliberations one last chance.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick believes Jay-Z has a ‘guilty conscience’ over deals with NFL and Target
headlines.description: Kaepernick made the comments as part of an extensive interview with NBC News ahead of the release of his memoir, “The Perilous Fight.”

headlines.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner for a year, docks team first-round draft picks from Kawhi Leonard probe
headlines.description: In one of the largest basketball-related penalties ever levied against an NBA franchise in the league’s history, the NBA on Wednesday fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and star Kawhi Leonard $700,000, suspended the team’s owner, Steve Ballmer, and two top executives and stripped the franchise of five first-round picks after ruling the team had circumvented the league’s salary cap rules.

headlines.title: Thousands of U.S. service members arrive in Thailand after record stint at sea
headlines.description: About 5,000 U.S. sailors and Marines are stopping in the resort city of Pattaya for a “rest and relaxation” break as they return home from a record-setting deployment in the Middle East.

headlines.description: AI “slop” is increasingly on offer at brick-and-mortar establishments.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: DOJ says states have to report undocumented immigrants to get federal funding
headlines.description: The Justice Department issued a new legal interpretation on Wednesday in an attempt to push every state in the country to report undocumented immigrants living in their communities and advance President Donald Trump’s mass deportation plan.

headlines.description: A judge set bail on Wednesday for the former Penn State fraternity brother at the center of an alleged cocaine trafficking ring.
